Tree select ​

Example data, control text, messages and source comments may be in Chinese. Viewer controls and API headings use English. Untranslated API descriptions are marked.

Interactive examples, TypeScript and JavaScript source, and the generated API reference are included on this page. The authored native API and migration tables are translated on this page.

When to use it ​

Choose nodes from static hierarchical options. Normalized nodes retain raw/children and support tree expansion and checking. ASAM value mode returns node values rather than full paths; select native explicitly for native models.

Hierarchical selection and custom nodes ​

The default slot receives data, node and the corresponding normalized option. filterable enables local filtering. Single selection clears to null.

<template>
	<div class="example">
		<AsamTreeSelect
			ref="control"
			v-bind="{ filterable: true, clearable: true, 'aria-label': '选择团队' }"
			v-model="value"
			:options="options"
			@change="event = JSON.stringify($event)"
		>
			<template #default="{ data }">{{ data.label }}节点</template>
			<template #empty>没有可选节点</template>
		</AsamTreeSelect>
		<AsamButton type="primary" @click="control?.focus()">聚焦</AsamButton>
		<output>值：{{ value }}；事件：{{ event }}</output>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTreeSelectBasicExample' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamTreeSelect, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamTreeSelectExpose } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const control = ref<AsamTreeSelectExpose>();
const options = [
	{
		label: '团队',
		value: 'team',
		raw: {},
		children: [
			{ label: '设计', value: 'design', raw: {} },
			{ label: '开发', value: 'dev', raw: {} }
		]
	}
];
const value = ref<string | null>('design');
const event = ref('尚未更改');
</script>

Multiple selection and object values ​

Multiple + valueMode=object returns normalized node arrays. String storage is only available in value mode. Separator must not occur in values; all node values must be unique.

Raw fields and instance ​

Native uses data and props to map a raw tree. getCheckedKeys reads actual checked nodes; setCheckedKeys changes checked states. The model synchronizes through component changes.

Example: native

Show source
Example source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div class="example">
		<AsamTreeSelect
			ref="control"
			v-bind="{
				...{
					'value-mode': 'native',
					'node-key': 'id',
					multiple: true,
					'show-checkbox': true
				},
				...{ data: nodes, props: { label: 'name', children: 'nodes' } }
			}"
			v-model="value"
		/>
		<AsamButton type="primary" @click="inspect">读取节点</AsamButton>
		<output>原始模型：{{ value }}；{{ inspected }}</output>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTreeSelectNativeExample' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamTreeSelect, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamTreeSelectExpose, AsamTreeSelectNativeProps } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const control = ref<AsamTreeSelectExpose>();
const value = ref<AsamTreeSelectNativeProps['modelValue']>([]);
const nodes = [
	{
		id: 'team',
		name: '团队',
		nodes: [
			{ id: 'design', name: '设计' },
			{ id: 'dev', name: '开发' }
		]
	}
];
const inspected = ref('');
function inspect() {
	inspected.value = JSON.stringify(control.value?.getCheckedKeys());
}
</script>

Sizes and inheritance ​

Four examples explicitly use large/big/default/small. Omitted sizes respond to ConfigProvider; explicit values override ancestors. Panels without a size contract do not acquire an extra size prop.

Example: sizes

		<div class="density-grid">
			<section data-density="large">
				<strong>large</strong>
				<AsamTreeSelect size="large" :options="options" model-value="design" />
			</section>
			<section data-density="big">
				<strong>big</strong>

ASAM extensions and migration ​

ASAM adds four densities and value/object, array/string policies. Static components do not handle request/dictType. Unknown values retain their display and are resolved when options arrive. Native uses raw data/field mapping, without normalized string storage. TreeSelect provides public tree instance methods; Cascader provides focus/blur, node access and popup operations.

update:modelValue/change infer payloads from valueMode, top-level or Cascader-nested multiple and multipleValueMode. Single values return node values/null; objects return normalized nodes/null; multiple selection returns writable value/object arrays. String storage returns string and clears to ''. CamelCase/kebab-case props follow the same rules. Single refs must allow null; do not replace a specific mode with an all-mode union. Native retains its declared model union and clear values. Initial arrays in path/multiple examples do not represent all output shapes. Narrow TS declarations are reusable.

Native parent models use ref<AsamTreeSelectNativeProps['modelValue']> to retain scalar, object, multiple and empty declarations. Numeric/array initial values do not replace the complete native contract.

Reading the API ​

The generated reference uses actual public types and runtime defaults. Combined props apply by branch; unknown or undeclared defaults do not mean false or empty. Complete Demo.vue files inline local helpers, data and assets.

Complete native usage and API ​

The following targets pinned 2.14.7. Cascader/TreeSelect examples explicitly use value-mode=native. Native values, paths, field mapping and callbacks cannot be applied directly to normalized modes. Native tables retain native defaults; ASAM overrides and four-size rules follow below. TreeSelect provides a dropdown with an expandable tree and the relevant native Tree/Select capabilities.

Selecting any level ​

Check-strictly=true permits selecting any level; otherwise only leaves can be selected. With show-checkbox, check-on-click-node defaults false: use checkboxes, or set it true for node-click selection. Check-on-click-leaf defaults true with checkboxes, allowing a leaf click to toggle selection.

Try node content.

With verified inputs on 2.14.7 / Vue 3.5.34, adding a default slot after mounting an instance without one did not display new node content. Native TreeSelect and ASAM native matched. A new instance supplied with the slot at mount displayed it. This initial-absence-to-addition case is a native compatibility limitation; new content is not guaranteed visible. Replacement, removal and other slots have separate verification results.

<script lang="ts" setup>


import { AsamTreeSelect, AsamDivider } from '@asam-ui/ui';
// Adapted from the fixed upstream MIT example: tree-select/lazy.vue

import { ref } from 'vue';

const value = ref<AsamTreeSelectNativeProps['modelValue']>();
const value2 = ref<AsamTreeSelectNativeProps['modelValue']>(5);

const cacheData = [{ value: 5, label: '节点五（懒加载）' }];

const props = {
	label: 'label',
	children: 'children',
	isLeaf: 'isLeaf'
};

let id = 0;

import type { AsamTreeSelectNativeProps } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const load: NonNullable<AsamTreeSelectNativeProps['load']> = (node, resolve) => {
	if (node.isLeaf) return resolve([]);

	setTimeout(() => {
		resolve([
			{
				value: ++id,
				label: `懒加载节点${id}`
			},
			{
				value: ++id,
				label: `懒加载节点${id}`,
				isLeaf: true
			}
		]);
	}, 400);
};
</script>

Using node-key ​

Native modelValue matches value by default. Supply node-key when the data structure differs. Keys must be unique across the whole tree. Value-key/node-key provide their respective value matching. Native tree selection does not directly return object values; use the ASAM object protocol described on this page.

API ​

Attributes ​

Native Tree and Select public capabilities retain their meanings. See their ASAM references alongside this page.

props Exposes Events Slots
Tree Tree Tree Tree
Select Select Select Select

Own attributes ​

Name Description Type Default
cache-data Cached lazy-node data, with the same structure as source data, supplies labels for unloaded nodes. arrayCacheOption[] []

Exposes ​

The upstream dependency deprecated the legacy methods directly exposed by TreeSelect, with removal planned for 3.0.0. They remain in pinned 2.14.7 and ASAM continues native delegation. Deprecation does not mean removal in this version.

New code accesses current treeRef/selectRef instances. The table below gives every migration: 18 tree methods move to treeRef; focus/blur move to selectRef; selectedLabel is read from selectRef as a value, not a method. Preserve arguments and return values, for example control.value?.treeRef.filter(query), control.value?.selectRef.focus() and control.value?.selectRef.selectedLabel. References point to live native instances; retain component hierarchy when calling methods.

Name Description Arguments / type Status and migration
treeRef Tree instance. AsamTreeInstance Current entry since 2.11.3.
selectRef Select instance. AsamTreeSelectExpose['selectRef'] Current entry since 2.11.3.
filter Filter all nodes, hiding those that do not match. One argument passed as the first filter-node-method argument. Deprecated; use treeRef.filter.
updateKeyChildren Replace a node's children; requires node-key. (key, data): node key and new data. Deprecated; use treeRef.updateKeyChildren.
getCheckedNodes Return checked nodes when show-checkbox=true. (leafOnly, includeHalfChecked): both default false. LeafOnly restricts to leaves; includeHalfChecked includes partial checks. Deprecated; use treeRef.getCheckedNodes.
setCheckedNodes Set checked nodes; requires node-key. Array of node objects to check. Deprecated; use treeRef.setCheckedNodes.
getCheckedKeys Return checked keys when show-checkbox=true. (leafOnly): default false; true returns checked leaves only. Deprecated; use treeRef.getCheckedKeys.
setCheckedKeys Set checked keys; requires node-key. (keys, leafOnly): key array and boolean, default false; true changes leaf checks only. Deprecated; use treeRef.setCheckedKeys.
setChecked Set a node's checked state; requires node-key. (key/data, checked, deep): identity/data, state and recursive child update. Since 2.14.0 recursion applies independently of check-strictly. Deprecated; use treeRef.setChecked.
getHalfCheckedNodes Return partially checked nodes when show-checkbox=true. — Deprecated; use treeRef.getHalfCheckedNodes.
getHalfCheckedKeys Return partially checked keys when show-checkbox=true. — Deprecated; use treeRef.getHalfCheckedKeys.
getCurrentKey Return the current node key, or null. — Deprecated; use treeRef.getCurrentKey.
getCurrentNode Return the current node data, or null. — Deprecated; use treeRef.getCurrentNode.
setCurrentKey Highlight by key; requires node-key. (key, shouldAutoExpandParent=true): null clears highlighting; second argument controls parent expansion. Deprecated; use treeRef.setCurrentKey.
setCurrentNode Set the current highlighted node. (node, shouldAutoExpandParent=true): node and parent expansion flag. Deprecated; use treeRef.setCurrentNode.
getNode Find a Tree node by data or key. (data): node data or key. Deprecated; use treeRef.getNode.
remove Remove a Tree node. (data): node data or node object. Deprecated; use treeRef.remove.
append Append a child node. (data, parentNode): child data and parent data/key/node object. Deprecated; use treeRef.append.
insertBefore Insert before a node. (data, refNode): new data and reference data/key/node object. Deprecated; use treeRef.insertBefore.
insertAfter Insert after a node. (data, refNode): new data and reference data/key/node object. Deprecated; use treeRef.insertAfter.
focus Focus the Select input. Function() => void Deprecated; use selectRef.focus.
blur Blur the input and hide its dropdown. Function() => void Deprecated; use selectRef.blur.
selectedLabel Read selected labels. objectComputedRef<string | string[]> Deprecated; use selectRef.selectedLabel.

ASAM modes and defaults ​

Default valueMode=value returns leaf/TreeSelect node values and clears single selection to null. Object mode returns normalized nodes with raw; multiple selection clears to []. Zero, false and empty strings are valid. Normalized Cascader fixes emitPath=false; use native for full paths. Explicit Cascader multiple wins over props.multiple. TreeSelect defaults checkStrictly=true; explicit false restores parent/child linkage. Multiple TreeSelect shows checkboxes by default; showCheckbox=false hides them.

Normalized multiple selection defaults to arrays. Value mode permits multipleValueMode=string with separator. Separators must be nonempty and absent from values; serialized tokens across the tree must not collide. Object/native modes reject string storage. Unknown selected values remain for restoration; loaded nodes provide actual labels without rewriting old host objects. Loader/options/valueMode changes isolate late callbacks.

Sizes use large/big/default/small and ConfigProvider inheritance. Native large/default/small tables do not describe all ASAM sizes. Base components accept options or host lazy callbacks. Remote/Dict entries own providers, searches and complete-tree retrieval.

TreeSelect composes native tree and selection capabilities: see Tree for filtering/checking/node operations and Select for input/tags/clearing/popups/keyboard/named slots. This page's normalized options/model/cacheData and default node slot retain their own contracts; sibling ASAM data models are not interchangeable. Cascader-specific expandChange/visibleChange/removeTag are not TreeSelect events. TreeSelect uses visible-change/remove-tag and actual node events.

Normalized lazy loading ​

load/lazyLoad returns { value, label, raw, children?, leaf?, isLeaf? }, not arbitrary native objects. Cascader defaults to leaf, TreeSelect to isLeaf. Map with props.leaf/props.isLeaf; extra fields can come from raw. Internal keys are typed strings, while business v-model keeps original values; native uses raw keys. Each resolve is accepted once. Duplicate values, cyclic trees and invalid string serialization throw type errors. Reject keeps native retry semantics. Recreated inline props with the same loader do not reinitialize dynamic nodes. validateEvent=false disables wrapper change validation; native form disabled inheritance continues.

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamTreeSelect, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamTreeSelectLoad, AsamHierarchyOption, AsamValue } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const version = ref(1);
const value = ref<AsamValue | null>(null);
const objectValue = ref<AsamHierarchyOption | null>(null);
const multiple = ref<AsamValue[]>([]);
const tokens = ref('');
const stringOptions = [
	{ value: 1, label: '一', raw: {} },
	{ value: 2, label: '二', raw: {} }
];
const load = computed<AsamTreeSelectLoad>(() => {
	const sourceVersion = version.value;
	return (node, resolve) => {
		setTimeout(() => {
			resolve(
				node.level === 0
					? [
							{
								value: 'root',
								label: '根节点 ' + sourceVersion,
								raw: { sourceVersion },
								leaf: false,
								isLeaf: false
							}
						]
					: [0, false, ''].map((value) => ({
							value,
							label:
								typeof value +
								':' +
								JSON.stringify(value) +
								' / 源' +
								sourceVersion,
							raw: { sourceVersion },
							leaf: true,
							isLeaf: true
						}))
			);
		}, 400);
	};
});
function restore() {
	value.value = 0;
	objectValue.value = { value: 0, label: '回填 0', raw: { restored: true } };
}
function clear() {
	value.value = null;
	objectValue.value = null;
	multiple.value = [];
	tokens.value = '';
}
function replace() {
	clear();
	version.value++;
}
</script>

Try normalized loading.

Inherited edge events and tag wrapper items ​

end-reached returns top/bottom/left/right at real dropdown scrollbar edges; it differs from popup-scroll's position object. Tag data is an AsamTreeSelectTagOption array. Items include currentLabel/value/index and optional isDisabled. DeleteTag takes MouseEvent and that wrapper item, not just a business value. In normalized mode wrapper values are internal native keys; pass the full wrapper when deleting. Business v-model still returns original values. This TreeSelect structure does not change Cascader's separate tag type.

Try inherited contracts.

Native forwarding and source updates ​

Label inherits Select's public scope: index is number; label/value retain open native slot types and must match actual node values.

Native mode directly delegates raw data/nodeKey/props/load/cacheData and preserves omitted native defaults. Its default slot receives native { data, node, store }; advanced normalized paths add optional option. Base source updates do not force remounts through ASAM advanced source epochs. Native code handles loading/checking/selection algorithms. treeRef/selectRef and public methods delegate live, preserving return values and this. Advanced value/object, array/string, normalized lazy data, unresolved options and validation retain this page's original contracts.

Local and global mounting ​

Change public mounting settings, then open the popup to inspect local or body mounting. The switch shows the current mode. Both modes work and can be changed after closing.
